trigger_condition: Question requests a diagnosis (naming/confirming a medical condition)
escalate_to: Human support agent -> instruct user to consult a qualified medical professional
reason: 'diagnosis' is listed 'not allowed without escalation' in the canonical answer policy

trigger_condition: Question requests or implies a cure claim for a product
escalate_to: Human support agent -> instruct user to consult a qualified medical professional
reason: 'cure claims' is listed 'not allowed without escalation'

trigger_condition: Two or more candidate answers conflict for the same symptom/product recommendation
escalate_to: Human support agent / content review team
reason: 'conflicting symptom-based recommendations' is listed 'not allowed without escalation'

trigger_condition: User asks about a contraindication/drug interaction not covered by an approved medical/regulatory source
escalate_to: Human support agent -> instruct user to consult a qualified medical professional
reason: 'contraindication advice without approved medical/regulatory source' is listed 'not allowed without escalation'

trigger_condition: User asks for disease-specific treatment guidance
escalate_to: Human support agent -> instruct user to consult a qualified medical professional
reason: 'disease-specific treatment language' is listed 'not allowed without escalation'

trigger_condition: User asks for a definitive retail profit %, mentorship bonus %, or business matching structure figure
reason: These 3 fields are CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED between the old KB and the GrowthX PDF; no human has picked a value yet

trigger_condition: User reports a payment problem (failed payment, double charge, payment not reflected)
source_document: "PaymentGatewayPolicy_Dayjoy.pdf explicitly directs payment issues to Customer Care with the order number",PaymentGatewayPolicy_Dayjoy.pdf

trigger_condition: User asks about order cancellation, return, refund, damaged product, delivery time, or return-shipping cost
escalate_to: Human support agent / Dayjoy operations team
reason: The 'Shipping/Refund Policy' cited as the source for these answers in the intents dataset does not exist anywhere in this repo (POL-GAP-01) — cannot be confidently self-served

trigger_condition: Requested fact has no matching row in any canonical file in this repository
reason: 'No source found at all -> abstain' per the claim verification standard; in a live support context this means hand off rather than leave the user unanswered

trigger_condition: Requested Dayjoy fact is marked UNVERIFIED with a genuine cross-source conflict (e.g. incorporation date, phone number variant, manufacturing capacity figures)
escalate_to: Human support agent / company records team
reason: dayjoy_company_knowledge.csv flags several fields as GENUINE CONFLICT between sources; do not pick one silently
